🛡️ Why does it need battery permission & autostart?
So the booster keeps running even when your phone is locked or the app is swiped away from recent apps. On MIUI/ColorOS/EMUI phones, also enable \'Autostart\' manually in phone settings.

This app boosts audio quality & volume across your entire phone system — not just inside this app, but also when you listen to music, watch videos, or play games in other apps.
Adds low-tone (bass) power so music feels more punchy.
Slide right for stronger bass. 0 = off, 1000 = maximum. Great for EDM, hip-hop, or small speakers that are usually weak on bass.
Makes sound feel wider and surround you, like a surround-sound effect.
This effect is most noticeable with earphones/headsets. Through phone speakers, the effect is subtler. Raise it gradually — too high a value can make some songs sound odd.
Adds volume beyond the system\'s normal limit (extra boost on top of your phone volume).
Useful when your phone volume is already maxed out but still not loud enough. Note: the higher the gain, the higher the risk of distortion — if it sounds distorted, turn it back down.
Why does the app ask for battery permission?
So the booster stays active even when your phone is locked or the app is swiped away from recent apps.

Android kills background apps by default to save battery. If this app gets killed, the boost effect disappears too. The \'ignore battery optimization\' permission prevents that. On Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo/Huawei phones, you may also need to manually enable \'Autostart\' in phone settings — the app can\'t do this automatically, that\'s an Android security policy.
While the booster is active, you\'ll see a small notification that can\'t be swiped away.

This isn\'t a bug — this notification is exactly what tells Android the app is doing \'important work\' so it doesn\'t get killed easily. Tap the \'Stop\' button in the notification itself if you want to fully stop the booster.
⚠️ Failed to connect to audio service
The app couldn\'t connect to the background service that runs the audio effects. Try force-closing and reopening the app.
